what: Ada writes, on A, a move naming no seat, a version of Bo's move for her own seat, and in a session S2 of hers a version of her move in S, each naming a row at an id not equivocated. A second copy of hers signs the same seqs as closes, which B holds. Every one of those ids is equivocated after either merge, so the three rows count for nothing and are reported nowhere but AUTHOR_EQUIVOCATED, in Ada's name, in both directions: no SEAT_NOT_HELD, for no seat or for another seat's version, and no ENTITY_OTHER_SESSION (R9).
